tabData.title: Commit to the Future: How GitHub and Copilot Are Changing the Way We Work
tabData.text:
Version control isn’t just for code anymore. From open source to AI-assisted creativity, GitHub and Copilot are redefining how we collaborate, learn, and build. This session explores how human insight and machine intelligence can merge to accelerate innovation — and what that means for everyone, not just developers.  

 Critical Skill : **AI Literacy**
tabData.name: Stu Fosker

tabData.title: IDP – Progress, what to do and what's next
tabData.text:
Learn how the IDP can benefit you in an Engineering or in a Non-Engineering Role, understanding the key Features and Capabilities that it provides and how these can support you in your day to day work.  

 Critical Skill : **Digital Literacy**
tabData.name: Dan Davy

tabData.title: From Concept to Cloud: Bridging the Prototype-to-Production Gap with Google Cloud's Well-Architected Framework
tabData.text:
Turning prototypes into production-ready cloud systems is challenging. While Design Thinking supports rapid iteration, early solutions often lack resilience and scalability. This talk explores how the Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework helps teams build secure, reliable, and efficient cloud deployments—without heavy governance overhead.  

 Critical Skill : **Solution & Technical Architecture**
tabData.name: Alex Stepney (Google)

tabData.title: Navigating the Next Wave of Tech Innovation
tabData.text:
Join Jamie Harbour (CTO Innovation) and a Google expert to explore the tech shaping our future—from quantum computing and neuromorphic design to generative AI and privacy-first solutions. Discover what’s real, what’s hype, and what LBG needs to know to stay ahead. Whether you’re an engineer or simply curious, this session will help you navigate the next wave of innovation.  

 Critical Skill : **Technology Intelligence​**
tabData.name: Jamie Harbour, Alex Stepney (Google)

tabData.title: Skills Based Organisation
tabData.text:
How we enhance and embed a skills-based capability and culture to develop a highly skilled workforce. Optimising career progression and mobility in-line with industry standard - a chance to hear more about Engineering Levels.  

 Critical Skill : **Learning & Talent Development**
tabData.name: Kelly Evans​, Paul Wild & Ryan Lau

tabData.title: From Pets to Cattle to Ghosts: The Evolution of Containers
tabData.text:
Infrastructure has evolved—from lovingly maintained servers (“pets”) to disposable VMs and orchestrated clusters (“cattle”). Now, serverless containers introduce “ghosts”: ephemeral workloads that appear when needed and vanish when idle, cutting waste and energy use. This talk explores why this shift matters for speed, cost, carbon, and resilience, and how it reshapes how we build and run applications—with insights on right-sizing, smart scheduling, and carbon-aware design.  

 Critical Skill : **SRE & Service Engineering**
tabData.name: Paul Gledhill

tabData.title: Technology Strategy 3.0: Our vision to be the UK’s Biggest FinTech
tabData.text:
Join us to reveal our latest technology strategy outlining how we Simplify to fix yesterday's complexities, Modernise with the technologies of today, Pioneer by building for tomorrow and Engineering with Excellence by putting the best talent, agile processes and tools at the heart of everything we do.  

 Critical Skill : **Technology Leadership​**
tabData.name: Kieran Coult & Chris French

tabData.title: Building blocks of Agents
tabData.text:
A technical deep dive for developers and architects on how to construct, connect, and deploy AI agents.  
 Critical Skill : **AI/ML Solution Design**
tabData.name: Prabhu Nair (Google)

tabData.title: Engineering Excellence for All
tabData.text:
Think tech’s just for engineers? Think again. In this panel, you'll hear real life examples of how our colleagues are using AI and digital tools to boost their everyday work. From applying an engineering mindset to embracing change and learning, this session will spark ideas and show how tech skills are for everyone. Come curious, leave inspired. 

 Critical Skill : **AI Literacy**
tabData.name: Amy McDaid​, Jonathan Smith & Claire Noble

tabData.title: Copilot & Your Career
tabData.text:
LDon’t ask AI — let AI ask you!  Want to get more out of your role and your career conversations? Discover how Copilot can help you transform your role, tee up great conversations about your job, as well as shape your career. This session is designed to give you real prompts, real examples, and real ways to make Copilot work for you.  

 Critical Skill : **Learning & Talent Development**
tabData.name: Sean Smith

tabData.title: Launching Front-End solutions through Interstellar (CDN/AEM)
tabData.text:
Launch new CWAs with no provisioning, engagements and have all the content branded with a few clicks!  

 Critical Skill : **UI & UX Design**
tabData.name: Daniel McCorley, Tomorr Rexhepi, Nadia Alam-Ibral, Alasdair Scott

tabData.title: Data Disasters - Data Resilience in the AI Age
tabData.text:
Did you know that 40% of Cyberattacks are now AI driven? In this presentation, the Data Resilience team will introduce you to the measures taken to protect the group from everything from Cyberattacks to Data Degradation with a focus on an AI as a force for good (or not!)​  

 Critical Skill : **Data Privacy, Ethics & Security**
tabData.name: Johnty Wright

tabData.title: Mac and Cheese Mainframe : Perfect Partners?
tabData.text:
Having been an early adopter of the Enterprise Mac initiative, this presentation looks at how two unlikely technologies (Mac and mainframe) work well together. Along the way it explores the modern mainframe and DevOps practices.  

 Critical Skill : **DevOps**
tabData.name: Philip Nelson​ & Jessica Huckson

tabData.title: The Future of Preventative Care: Remote Health Monitoring with Computer Vision
tabData.text:
LBG is building a healthcare ecosystem in its apps to make healthy living easy and rewarding. This talk explores key technologies we’re testing and includes a remote health check so you can experience the future of healthcare first-hand.  

 Critical Skill : **Sustainable Technologies**
tabData.name: Bea Schofield

tabData.title: Next-Level Collaboration: Confluence, Jira & AI at LBG​​
tabData.text:
We’re taking teamwork to new heights! With Confluence now in the cloud and Jira soon to follow, discover how these tools can transform the way we work at LBG. This session will introduce the cloud features, highlight key differences from the old setup, and give you a sneak peek at Rovo—Atlassian’s new AI assistant that’s set to change the way we find, create, and collaborate.​  

 Critical Skill : **Agile Methodology & Tools​**
tabData.name: Hilary Lanham, Adam Wood (Atlassian) & Richard Morton (Atlassian)

tabData.title: How IDP will drive the success of the future of application development
tabData.text:
Discover how IDP boosts app development by making existing and new applications composable by default—driving the Bank’s digital transformation. Learn how Business Platforms can accelerate delivery and manage their own experience using IDP’s federated tools for development, integration, and governance. 

 Critical Skill : **Solution & Technical Architecture**
tabData.name: Paul Caroll

tabData.title: Unmasking Imposter Syndrome, Part 2 with ASPIRE
tabData.text:
Tell us if this sounds familiar. You’re new and excited about your role, but self-doubt creeps in when you discover you don't know as much as others. Or maybe your experience spans decades, but the higher you climb, the more pressure, stress, and burnout you feel. This ASPIRE-led talk tackles the workplace’s biggest unspoken challenge, one that affects 70% of adults (and even more women in senior roles). You’ll hear real stories, gain practical tools, and leave with renewed confidence, resilience, and a sense of empowerment.​ 

 Critical Skill : **Emotional Intelligence**
tabData.name: Ugonna Okoro & Anika Hussain

tabData.title: Qigong
tabData.text:
Looking for a way to relax and recharge? Join us for Qigong – a fun, light-hearted practice that blends mindfulness, breathwork, tapping, and gentle rhythmic movements.Qi (life energy) flows through all living things, and Qigong helps you connect with it. It’s a simple way to de-stress, slow down, and feel more balanced and present. Come with an open mind and a sense of humour – some moves may feel a little silly, and that’s part of the fun!​  
 Critical Skill : **Resilience Wellbeing & Adaptability**
tabData.name: Victoria Jardine

tabData.title: 'Letting Go' - ​Afternoon Meditation
tabData.text:
We often hold on to the past and worry about the future.  This is like a burden we carry and stops us being light and easy.  Join us for a short meditation to experience being in the present. 

 Critical Skill : **Resilience Wellbeing & Adaptability**
tabData.name: Parul Shah

tabData.title: Finding my feet at Google
tabData.text:
Google has an image of being a fun and cool place to work with lots of perks but how in a big corporation do you navigate a line between the demands of the business and the potential benefits available to you. Andy Mather, just passed his 6th Google anniversary, will reflect on his journey and also on how to maintain a balance in an increasingly AI driven workplace.  

 Critical Skill : **Resilience Wellbeing & Adaptability**

tabData.title: An Introduction to the Agent Development Kit
tabData.text:
This technical session is a deep dive into the Agent Development Kit (ADK), our powerful framework for building, testing, and deploying autonomous AI agents. 

 Critical Skill : **AI/ML Solution Design**
tabData.name: Google

tabData.title: Dev Containers for LBG Engineering
tabData.text:
Join us for a hands-on workshop exploring how to effectively use dev containers in your development workflow. This session is curated by the Software Engineering CoE (CTO) to align with LBG’s standards for tooling, compliance, and strategic programming languages. Dev containers streamline environment setup, enabling you to build software that is secure, reproducible, and enterprise-ready - accelerating delivery while maintaining engineering excellence.  
 Critical Skill : **Software Engineering** 

 **LBG Laptop Required**
tabData.name: Fangkang Mi

tabData.title: AI Workshop: Agent Engine, NotebookLM and Gemini Enterprise
tabData.text:
In this hands-on workshop you’ll get your hands on the three most powerful tools in our AI stack: Agent Engine, NotebookLM and Gemini Enterprise. Don't just listen to what's next in AI. Come and build it. 
 
 Critical Skill : **AI/ML Solution Design**
tabData.name: Google

tabData.title: Emerging Tech Radar: The Tech to Watch in 2026
tabData.text:
To stay a leading player tomorrow, we need to think about the future today. The 2026 Emerging Technology Radar is here, spotlighting the innovations set to reshape financial services and beyond. Join ET&I’s Alisha Mukherjee as she unpacks the tech gaining traction, what we should pay attention to and why it matters. We’ll separate the hype from reality and invite you to explore and ideate how these could be harnessed in your team’s future.​  
 Critical Skill : **Technology Intelligence​**
tabData.name: Alisha Mukherjee

tabData.title: Work smarter to get faster
tabData.text:
Through game-based learning you will develop the skills to better understand how much work you have in progress, how to avoid blockers and improve your speed of delivery. You'll learn how to deliver more without working any harder.  
 Critical Skill : **Agile Plan & Resource Management​**
tabData.name: Dee Adam

tabData.title: Introducing Customer Lifecycle Management
tabData.text:
Learn about what the Group's new Customer Lifecycle Management framework is all about, the key learnings from the early-adopter pilot in IP&I and how you can start to apply in your work  
 Critical Skill : **Customer Centricity**
tabData.name: Al Verity, Julie Lockhart & Simon Goldsmith

tabData.title: Harnessing insights though Dialogue with Data
tabData.text:
Imagine asking databases questions in plain English and getting instant answers. This workshop introduces Dialogue with Data—an AI-powered tool from ET&I and Nerve Centre that makes finding insights fast and easy, without technical skills. See it in action, explore use cases, and share ideas on how it could transform the way we work. 

 Critical Skill : **Data Literacy** 

 **LBG Laptop Required**
tabData.name: Ansel Liu​

tabData.title: Serverless Superpowers with Google Cloud Run
tabData.text:
Supercharge your serverless skills in this practical workshop focused on Google Cloud Run. Learn to deploy and scale containerised apps with ease, secure your services, and build reactive systems using Pub/Sub and Cloud Storage triggers. You’ll also explore traffic splitting, service revisions, and encryption with CMEK. ​​Ideal for engineers, developers, and platform teams working in cloud-native environments. 

 Critical Skill : **Cloud Orchestration & Maintenance Techniques** 

 **LBG Laptop Required**
tabData.name: Jack Stuart & Siham Fiqow​

tabData.title: Project in an Hour!
tabData.text:
Can you scaffold a project in an hour? 'Scaffold' ..? - produce all the designs and documentation - down to JIRA ticket level - for a brand-new project, maybe not alone. But with Copilot? Let’s find out. This fun, fast-paced “prompt-a-thon” explores how far Copilot can accelerate setup for architects and engineers ready to push the limits.  
 Critical Skill : **Solutions Design** 

 **LBG Laptop Required**
tabData.name: Mike Evans & Magda Widera

tabData.title: Building and deploying apps with the Internal Developer Platform
tabData.text:
Join us for an immersive hands-on technical workshop where we will guide you through the process of creating an app using our Internal Developer Platform, providing a comprehensive engineer's experience from start to finish.​ We will provide you with all the necessary access and resources, along with step-by-step guidelines. Our experts will be on hand to assist and answer any questions you may have, ensuring you gain practical, hands-on experience.  

 Critical Skill : **Software Engineering** 

 **LBG Laptop Required**
tabData.name: Gordon Shiell

tabData.title: Agile Journeys Live: Panel, Play & Problem-Solve
tabData.text:
An energising session where Change Job Family colleagues share their personal journeys into Agile: what they did before, how they discovered Agile ways of working, and the key lessons they’ve learned. The panel focuses on mindset and practical experience. The session wraps up with breakout groups tackling real team challenges using Agile thinking.  
 Critical Skill : **Agile Coaching**
tabData.name: Sarah Grainger​, Fiona Sung​, Alexa Atherton​, Justin Kirby & Dee Adam

tabData.title: Reboot Rapid Connect: Fast Track Your Network
tabData.text:
Skip the awkward small talk and make meaningful connections, fast. In this  80‑minute, game‑style session, you’ll meet a mix of engineers and  non‑engineers from across LBG to swap ideas, share challenges, and find your  next mentor, mentee, or teammate. We’ll kick off with Love & Challenge stickers (one thing you love about your role; one current challenge), then  rotate through short, energising conversations where you’ll guess each other’s roles from the clues. You’ll leave with 3–5 warm intros, a shortlist  of mentor/mentee matches, and a simple way to keep the conversation going after Reboot. Open to all colleagues, whether you’re curious, coaching, or just here to meet great people.​  
 Critical Skill : **Collaboration**
tabData.name: Chloe Solvey & Charlotte Cullen
